title: IFRA joins EFfCI Annual Conference 2026 in Athens
summary: IFRA took part in the EFfCI Annual Conference 2026 in Athens, with a presentation on regulation and innovation and a place on the conference’s ​ ‘ Four Musketeers’ panel on global and regional harmonization and dialogue between policymakers and industry.

extraction.key_fact: 국제향료협회가 아테네에서 열린 화장품 원료 협회 연례 컨퍼런스에 참가하여 규제와 혁신을 발표하고 글로벌 조화 패널 토론에 참여했다.
